_meta.definition: secured_gross_mw = energized + committed/under-construction gross facility power, MW. Speculative pipeline and pending interconnection EXCLUDED. Where the company discloses only critical IT load, converted x1.25 and flagged in basis.
_meta.refresh_rule: Refresh at quarterly rescore and on earnings (rule 9 pass). Used by batch_score.py to compute EV/MW for the Layer 9 capacity cohort (rule 13).
_meta.band_anchor: AI DC replacement cost ~$9-10M per gross MW (~$11-12M per IT MW), facility+power excl. IT gear

CRWV.basis: company 'contracted power', IT-vs-gross unspecified (treated gross, flagged) | Q3 2026 refresh (2026-11-19): contracted power >4.6 GW at 2026-09-30 (floor of stated '>4.6 GW'; grew >900 MW in Q3 from 3.7 GW at 2026-06-30), of which >1.3 GW outside the US (India, Indonesia, Spain); active power >1.7 GW (+>200 MW in Q3), YE26 active target >1.85 GW unchanged. Q3 10-Q does not restate contracted power; its lease notes show 453 MW + 354 MW still undelivered under construction-cost leases (2026-2028), consistent with contracted > active. Prior 4,200 MW was the 2026-08-11 intra-quarter figure. Helios still discloses IT-vs-gross ratio ~1.52 (526 IT / 800 gross), evidence the x1.25 convention may understate gross for IT-quoted leases.
CRWV.source: Q3 2026 earnings release, 8-K Ex-99.1 filed 2026-11-10 (acc 0001769628-26-000461); 10-Q Q3 2026 filed 2026-11-12 (acc 0001769628-26-000465) lease notes; per-stock/CRWV/context-2026-11-14.md

APLD.basis: 1,410 MW contracted critical IT across 5 AI Factory campuses (10-Q: 'aggregate contracted critical IT load is 1,410 MW') x1.25 = 1,762.5 gross-equiv + 286 MW legacy hosting gross (Jamestown 106 + legacy Ellendale 180, both 'operating at full capacity') = 2,048.5. Same basis as prior (contracted IT x1.25 + legacy gross). 10-Q per-campus building capacity: PF1 400 (250 live at 2026-10-01) / PF2 300 / PF3 300 / DF1 300 / DF2 210 = 1,510 MW under construction or live, i.e. ~100 MW above leased; campus of the unleased 100 MW not disclosed. EXCLUDED as speculative: Finland 'up to ~1 GW of potential power capacity'; Base Electron PPA (~1,200 MW gas plant to be developed for the PF3 expansion, terminable if no financial close by 2027-03-31); ChronoScale/Microsoft 50 MW compute deployment (compute, not APLD facility power; double-count risk). ~2.15 GW grid-connected figure (June PR) not restated in Q1 FY27 filings.
APLD.source: 10-Q Q1 FY27 (period 2026-08-31) filed 2026-10-07 (acc 0001144879-26-000059), lease note + MD&A 'HPC Hosting Business' / 'Data Center Hosting Business' + subsequent events; Q1 FY27 earnings 8-K Ex-99.1 filed 2026-10-07 (acc 0001144879-26-000057)

IREN.basis: Same energized + committed/under-construction standard as prior. FY26 10-K site table (gross MW, as of 2026-06-30): Childress 750 + Sweetwater 1 1,400 + Sweetwater 2 600 + Canal Flats 30 + Mackenzie 80 + Prince George 50 = 2,910. Inclusion test: Q1 FY27 10-Q lists committed capex for Childress (Horizons 1-6), Sweetwater 1 and Sweetwater 2, and the BC AI-cloud transition. EXCLUDED: Kiowa OK 1,600 and Bundey AU 800 ('early-stage development'), Badajoz Spain 300 (acquired June 2026; civil-works licence secured, no construction or committed capex disclosed). All three hold executed grid connection agreements/LOAs, so the company headline '>5 GW secured power' (table sum 5,610) includes them; this entry does not. Flags: Q1 FY27 release calls Mackenzie a '100MW site' (10-K table: 80); the release groups Sweetwater 2 with Kiowa/Bundey as 'early-stage development' (kept on committed-capex evidence); ERCOT Batch Zero procedure changes 'may delay energization' of Texas projects (10-K/10-Q risk factors).
IREN.source: IREN Q1 FY27 results 8-K Ex-99.1 filed 2026-11-05 (acc 0001878848-26-000065); 10-Q period 2026-09-30 filed 2026-11-05 (acc 0001878848-26-000066), MD&A 'Power availability and data center construction' + commitments; FY26 10-K filed 2026-08-27 (acc 0001878848-26-000052), Item 1 data-center table + Item 2 Properties

CORZ.basis: company 'Gross Utility Power Capacity' (10-Q MD&A definition: total electric utility power capacity agreements at data center sites under CORZ control, incl. capacity commissioned for future use). Same basis as prior 1,900, which was the Q1 10-Q's rounded '~1.9 GW' (table value 1,860 at 2026-03-31). 11 data centers, 7 states (prior: 10). Path: 1,426 (12/31/25) -> 1,860 (3/31) -> 2,115 (6/30) -> 2,550 (9/30). Q3 step +435 = Polaris DS acquisition at Muskogee OK (closed 2026-08-13; ESAs for up to 440 MW gross). Q2 step +255 coincides with Hunt County TX (closed 2026-05-05; ~430 MW gross expected, ERCOT ramp schedule); the 10-Q does not reconcile the difference. Both new sites now carry AMD/neocloud leases (Hunt 110, Muskogee 82 MW IT), so committed. EXCLUDED: contingent +40 MW Polaris DS earn-out; AMD 1,925 MW reservation right (non-binding per 10-Q); ~600 MW under load study (Pecos, Muskogee); ~940 MW behind-the-meter pathways; '2 GW+' new-site opportunities. Gross disclosed directly, no x1.25. Leasable IT 1,675 MW, of which 1,120 leased (CoreWeave 590 + AMD/neocloud 530) and 485 billing.
CORZ.source: 10-Q Q3 2026 filed 2026-11-05 (acc 0001839341-26-000030), MD&A capacity-metrics table + Note 3 Asset Acquisitions; Q3 earnings 8-K filed 2026-11-05 (acc 0001839341-26-000028) Ex-99.1 release + investor deck; Q2 10-Q filed 2026-07-28 (acc 0001839341-26-000014) table for 3/31 and 6/30

CIFR.source: 8-K filed 2026-11-02 (acc 0001819989-26-000047) Ex.99.2 'Q3 Business Update' slides 5, 13, 15-16 + Ex.99.1 earnings release; 10-Q period 2026-09-30 (acc 0001819989-26-000050) Note 1 Organization
